Please find below our comparative analysis of NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) for the morning briefing.

=== EXECUTIVE SUMMARY ===

Both semiconductor giants remain in focus amid evolving AI chip competition, though they present distinct risk/reward profiles. NVIDIA:
• Market leadership in AI accelerators with ~80%+ data center GPU share

• Strategic $2B investment in Synopsys strengthens EDA toolchain integration

• Elevated valuation remains sensitive to growth deceleration
